name: codex-orchestrator
description: Run reusable Codex team workflows, steer active work, inspect agent trees, and export results.

interface.longDescription: Queue reusable feature, bugfix and review workflows; steer active tasks; pause dispatch; inspect native agents and reported usage; export results through a local CLI and MCP server installed separately.
capabilities: Review agent status and event history
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Orchestrator for multi-step work that benefits from durable tasks, dependencies, or progress visibility.
